item.title: Do_not_track
item.description:
📝 Many CLI tools, SDKs, and frameworks collect telemetry data by default. There are too many, and they are all different. A single, standard environment variable that clearly and unambiguously expresses a user's wish to opt out of any of the following: Add the line above to your shell configuration file so it applies to all your terminal sessions: If you develop tools that collect telemetry, analytics, or make non-essential network requests, please check for this variable:.
🔗 Read more: https://donottrack.sh/

item.title: Neanderthals ran 'fat factories' 125,000 years ago
item.description:
📝 From complete bones to tiny fragments. In 2023, the team published evidence that Neanderthals hunted and butchered straight-tusked elephants—up to 13-ton animals that could provide over 2,000 adult daily food portions. They show that Neanderthals could plan ahead, process food efficiently and make sophisticated use of their environment.
🔗 Read more: https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/news/2025/07/neanderthals-ran-fat-factories-125000-years-ago

item.title: Welcome to Hell Developer
item.description:
📝 I figured maybe there was a debug mode or some hidden diagnostic that could help me figure out what was going wrong. If you could bump that to DEV (3), a whole debug menu unlocks under Settings > Device > Advanced.
